answer: Multiple customer signals report reduced boot volume caused by hybrid batteries, missing/electric tailgates or internal shut buttons, lack of luggage fittings, and unreliable tailgate operation — directly opposing the requirement’s usability and reliability targets. No bench‑test results are provided to show the 99%/500‑cycle target is achievable; owner reports of failures imply real‑world experience may not meet the <0.5% 12‑month target. The EV architecture press coverage is supportive but prospective and does not refute current complaints.
suggested_change: Make an interior shut button and luggage tie‑downs mandatory; require pre‑launch bench tests plus early field pilot validation of tailgate reliability before sign‑off (or allow a relaxed initial owner‑failure threshold until field data confirm <0.5%).
